{{Top|leg}}
A '''nerve rack''' was a torture device used in the extraction and collection of coveted information being withheld by a being. Energy pulses would be infused into the [[nervous system]] of the interrogation victim by means of electrodes attached to various parts of their anatomy. The interrogator could then control the intensity of the charges to ensure the cooperation of the prisoner.
